hypothesis: Requiring spatially distributed repeated support reduces wrong-sign differential noise corrections from a small unrepresentative common-flat support. A total-count gate isolates whether spatial distribution adds value beyond sample count.
data: Procedural linear-RGB only; no natural-image inputs or held-out manifests are read
texture_generator: Existing run_phase2_diagnostics.textures(96); mixed joins its sine left half and stochastic right half
defocus: Gaussian sigma=1.5 spatial axes, reflect; complementary vertical sharp-source masks
generation_order: Transform clear target brightness; form complementary sharp/blurred sources; draw independent RGB noise for A then B from one seeded generator; clip to [0,1]
common_support: Existing 8x8 blocks, eroded unsaturated valid_support, lowest20% max(A,B) smoothed-gradient energy; at least2 selected blocks for an estimate
count_gate: Use the shared contrast only if selected block count >=8; otherwise delta=0
spatial_gate: Partition image into4 equal quadrants; use contrast only if each quadrant contains >=2 selected block centers; otherwise delta=0
gate_rationale: Two samples per spatial stratum provide a minimal within-stratum repeatability condition; four quadrants cover the fixed image domain. These are fixed operational criteria, not calibrated probability bounds.
fallback: Zero differential mean correction, retaining the same global-sigma variance model and postprocessing
fixed_fusion: Same candidate implementation from probe_shared_support.py: kappa4, window7, epsilon_variance1e-8, sigmoid, median7, existing guided filter
oracle: Known pre-clipping independent RGB Gaussian variances propagated through fixed luminance weights. Clipping changes effective residual statistics; oracle_preclip supplies the pre-clipping model.
metrics: delta error to known preclip contrast
wrong sign on asymmetric noise among nonzero corrections
timing: One timed end-to-end call per condition/method after3 warmup calls per method on a fixed small fixture; includes estimator and fusion, excludes data generation and quality metrics; single numerical-library thread; exploratory cloud CPU timing
source_swap: Evaluate spatial-gate pipeline on (B,A) for every condition; record maximum output difference and opposite estimated contrast
analysis: Report by brightness and noise symmetry; compare shared vs count vs spatial gate, with coverage/abstention and worst losses. No parameter selection from observed PSNR.
stopping_condition: Complete this144-condition grid, tests, report and authorized code/numeric publication. No additional grid or threshold changes in this round.
